# Finding common cell types in human tumors

## Read data

```{r, include=FALSE}
library(here)
library(dplyr)
library(tibble)
library(Seurat)
library(SeuratDisk)
library(SeuratObject)
library(ggplot2)
library(gt)
library(patchwork)
library(future)
library(tidyr)
library(monocle3)
library(clustree)
library(qs2)
library(paletteer)
library(htmlwidgets)
```

```{r eval=TRUE}
ids <- c(
  "GSM8058157_KK22-H-225",
"GSM8058158_KK22-H-226", 
"GSM8058159_KK22-H-227",
"GSM8058160_KK23-H-507",
"GSM8058161_KK23-H-508",
"GSM8058162_KK23-H-509",
"GSM8058163_KK23-H-510",
"GSM8058164_KK23-H-511",
"GSM8058165_KK23-H-512"
)

path <- sapply(ids, function(x) paste0(here::here(), "/defaria/snRNA/data/raw/GSE254819_RAW/", x, "/"))

# can't use soupx because these seem to be filtered already...

read_data <- Read10X(path)

snrna.data <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = read_data, project = "snfixedtumor")

sample_info <- df <- tribble(
  ~orig.ident,      ~Sample_ID,   ~Tumor_Type,
  "GSM8058157", "KK22-H-225", "C19MC",
  "GSM8058158", "KK22-H-226", "C19MC",
  "GSM8058159", "KK22-H-227", "Dicer",
  "GSM8058160", "KK23-H-507", "C19MC",
  "GSM8058161", "KK23-H-508", "C19MC",
  "GSM8058162", "KK23-H-509", "C19MC",
  "GSM8058163", "KK23-H-510", "C19MC",
  "GSM8058164", "KK23-H-511", "C19MC",
  "GSM8058165", "KK23-H-512", "C19MC")


snrna.data@meta.data <- snrna.data@meta.data %>%
  rownames_to_column(var = "rownames") %>%
  right_join(sample_info, by = "orig.ident") %>%
  column_to_rownames(var = "rownames")

saveRDS(snrna.data, paste0(here::here(), "/defaria/snRNA/data/combined_fixed_tumors_raw.rds"))

```

## Filter, normalize, and find variable features

```{r eval=FALSE}

snrna.data[["percent.mt"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(snrna.data, pattern = "^MT-")

snrna.data <- subset(snrna.data, subset = nFeature_RNA > 200 & nFeature_RNA < 6000 & nCount_RNA < 40000 & percent.mt < 15)

snrna.data <- NormalizeData(snrna.data, normalization.method = "LogNormalize",
  scale.factor = 10000)

snrna.data <- FindVariableFeatures(snrna.data, selection.method = "vst")
```

## Unintegrated

### Run PCA

```{r eval=FALSE}
snrna.data <- ScaleData(snrna.data, verbose = FALSE)

#When you run this with features = NULL you use variable features by default
snrna.data <- RunPCA(snrna.data, verbose = FALSE, seed.use = 2026, reduction.name = "unint_pca", npcs = 50) 

```

```{r, eval=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
source("~/Projects/etmr/defaria/scripts/functions.R")

snrna.data <- run_umap(snrna.data, red="unint_pca")
```

```{r eval=FALSE}

saveRDS(snrna.data, paste0(here::here(), "/defaria/snRNA/data/combined_fixed_tumors.rds"))
```

### Clustering (start here)

```{r}
source("~/Projects/etmr/defaria/scripts/functions.R")

snrna.data <- readRDS(paste0(here::here(), "/defaria/snRNA/data/combined_fixed_tumors.rds"))

clus_unint <- DimPlot(snrna.data,
        reduction = "umap_unintegrated",
        group.by = "unintegrated_clusters",
        label = TRUE,
        raster = FALSE,
        pt.size = .5,
        shuffle = TRUE,
        alpha = .6) + ggtitle("Leiden clusters resolution 1.8")

id_unint <- DimPlot(snrna.data,
        reduction = "umap_unintegrated",
        group.by = "orig.ident",
        label = FALSE,
        raster = FALSE,
        pt.size = .5,
        shuffle = TRUE,
        alpha = .6
        ) + ggtitle("Sample ID")


mutation_unint <- DimPlot(snrna.data,
        reduction = "umap_unintegrated",
        group.by = "Tumor_Type",
        label = FALSE,
        raster = FALSE,
        pt.size = .5,
        shuffle = TRUE,
        alpha = .6
        ) + ggtitle("Tumor mutation")


unint_patch <- id_unint / mutation_unint / clus_unint + plot_annotation(title = "Unintegrated UMAP")


```

### Histograms

```{r}
#Make dataframe for ggplotting flexibility
unint_umapdf <- snrna.data@meta.data |>
  dplyr::select(orig.ident, unintegrated_clusters, Tumor_Type) |>
  rownames_to_column("cell")

unint_hist_id <- plot_hist(unint_umapdf, "unintegrated_clusters", "orig.ident") + labs(title = "Sample ID", fill = "Sample ID")
unint_hist_mut <- plot_hist(unint_umapdf, "unintegrated_clusters", "Tumor_Type") + labs(title = "Mutation", fill = "Mutation")

unint_id_pct <- unint_umapdf |>
  dplyr::count(unintegrated_clusters, orig.ident) |>
  dplyr::group_by(unintegrated_clusters) |>
  dplyr::mutate(percentage = n / sum(n) * 100)

unint_mut_pct <- unint_umapdf |>
  dplyr::count(unintegrated_clusters, Tumor_Type) |>
  dplyr::group_by(unintegrated_clusters) |>
  dplyr::mutate(percentage = round(n / sum(n) * 100,2)) 

dicer_sel_clus <- unint_mut_pct |>
  dplyr::filter(Tumor_Type == "Dicer" & 75 > percentage & percentage >= 25) |>
  dplyr::ungroup() |>
  dplyr::rename() |>
  gt(groupname_col = "Tumor_Type",
    row_group_as_column = TRUE) |>
  cols_label(
    unintegrated_clusters = "Cluster",
    n = "# of cells",
    percentage = "Percentage"
  ) |>
  tab_style(
    style = list(
      cell_fill(color = "lightcyan"),
      "font-variant: small-caps;",
      cell_text(v_align = "middle")
    ),
    locations = cells_row_groups()
  ) |>
  tab_header(
    title = "Selected clusters",
    subtitle = "Leiden clustering on unintegrated data (res = 1.8)"
  )

unint_plots <- ((id_unint + theme(legend.position = "none", plot.title=element_blank())) + 
    (unint_hist_id + theme(plot.title=element_blank()))) /
  ((mutation_unint + theme(legend.position = "none", plot.title=element_blank())) + 
     (unint_hist_mut + theme(plot.title=element_blank())))/
  ((clus_unint + theme(legend.position = "none", plot.title=element_blank())) + dicer_sel_clus) + plot_annotation(title = "Untintegrated")


ggsave(paste0(here::here(), "/defaria/snRNA/plots/umaps/1.8/unintegrated/tumors/unint_plots.png"), unint_plots,height = 12, width = 12, units = "in")
```

```{r calculate_average_expression}

unint_marks <- FindAllMarkers(snrna.data, group.by = "unintegrated_clusters", only.pos = TRUE)

  dplyr::group_by(cluster) |>
  dplyr::arrange(desc(avg_log2FC), .by_group=TRUE

  dplyr::ungroup() |>

  unlist(cellmarkers))
)

celltype_markers |>
  group_by(cluster) |>
  arrange(desc(avg_log2FC), .by_group=TRUE
          )

celltype_markers <- celltype_markers %>%
  dplyr::mutate(celltype = gene_to_celltype[gene])

sel_marks <- unint_marks |>
  dplyr::filter((pct.1 >= .25 | pct.2 >= .25) & avg_log2FC >= .5)

View(sel_marks)
```

## Integration

### MNN

```{r mnn, warning=FALSE}
library(SeuratWrappers)
source("~/Projects/etmr/defaria/scripts/functions.R")
snrna.data <- readRDS(paste0(here::here(), "/defaria/snRNA/data/combined_fixed_tumors_raw.rds"))

split_snrna <- SplitObject(snrna.data, split.by = "orig.ident")
split_snrna <- lapply(split_snrna, function(x) {
  x[["percent.mt"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(x, pattern = "^MT-")
  x <- subset(x, subset = nFeature_RNA > 200 & nFeature_RNA < 6000 & nCount_RNA < 40000 & percent.mt < 15)
  x <- NormalizeData(x, normalization.method = "LogNormalize", scale.factor = 10000)
  x <- FindVariableFeatures(x, selection.method = "vst")
  x <- ScaleData(x, verbose = FALSE)
  return(x)
})

split_snrna <- RunFastMNN(object.list = split_snrna, reduction.name = "integrated.mnn")

split_snrna <- RunUMAP(split_snrna, reduction = "integrated.mnn", dims = 1:30, reduction.name = "mnn.umap", return.model = TRUE)
split_snrna <- FindNeighbors(split_snrna, reduction = "integrated.mnn", dims = 1:30)
split_snrna <- FindClusters(split_snrna, cluster.name	= "mnn_clusters", resolution = 1.8, random.seed = 2026, algorithm = 4)

```

```{r}
 
split_snrna@meta.data$mnn_clusters <- as.factor(as.numeric(split_snrna@meta.data$mnn_clusters))

clus_mnn <- DimPlot(split_snrna,
        reduction = "mnn.umap",
        group.by = "mnn_clusters",
        label = TRUE,
        raster = FALSE,
        pt.size = .5,
        shuffle = TRUE,
        alpha = .6) + ggtitle("Leiden clusters resolution 1.8")


id_mnn <- DimPlot(split_snrna,
        reduction = "mnn.umap",
        group.by = "orig.ident",
        label = FALSE,
        raster = FALSE,
        pt.size = .5,
        shuffle = TRUE,
        alpha = .6
        ) + ggtitle("Sample ID")


mutation_mnn <- DimPlot(split_snrna,
        reduction = "mnn.umap",
        group.by = "Tumor_Type",
        label = FALSE,
        raster = FALSE,
        pt.size = .5,
        shuffle = TRUE,
        alpha = .6
        ) + ggtitle("Tumor mutation")


mnn_patch <- id_mnn / mutation_mnn / clus_mnn + plot_annotation(title = "Integrated UMAP: MNN")


```

```{r}
mnn_umapdf <- split_snrna@meta.data |>
  select(orig.ident, mnn_clusters, Tumor_Type) |>
  rownames_to_column("cell")

mnn_hist_id <- plot_hist(mnn_umapdf, "mnn_clusters", "orig.ident") + labs(title = "Sample ID", fill = "Sample ID")

mnn_hist_mut <- plot_hist(mnn_umapdf, "mnn_clusters", "Tumor_Type") + labs(title = "Mutation", fill = "Mutation")

mnn_id_pct <- mnn_umapdf |>
  dplyr::count(mnn_clusters, orig.ident) |>
  group_by(mnn_clusters) |>
  mutate(percentage = n / sum(n) * 100)

mnn_mut_pct <- mnn_umapdf |>
  dplyr::count(mnn_clusters, Tumor_Type) |>
  group_by(mnn_clusters) |>
  mutate(percentage = round(n / sum(n) * 100,2)) 

dicer_sel_clus_mnn <- mnn_mut_pct |>
  dplyr::filter(Tumor_Type == "Dicer" & 75 > percentage & percentage >= 25) |>
  ungroup() |>
  dplyr::rename() |>
  gt(groupname_col = "Tumor_Type",
    row_group_as_column = TRUE) |>
  cols_label(
    mnn_clusters = "Cluster",
    n = "# of cells",
    percentage = "Percentage"
  ) |>
  tab_style(
    style = list(
      cell_fill(color = "lightcyan"),
      "font-variant: small-caps;",
      cell_text(v_align = "middle")
    ),
    locations = cells_row_groups()
  ) |>
  tab_header(
    title = "Selected clusters",
    subtitle = "Leiden clustering on MNN-corrected data (res = 1.8)"
  )

mnn_plots <- ((id_mnn + theme(legend.position = "none", plot.title=element_blank())) + 
    (mnn_hist_id + theme(plot.title=element_blank()))) /
  ((mutation_mnn + theme(legend.position = "none", plot.title=element_blank())) + 
     (mnn_hist_mut + theme(plot.title=element_blank())))/
  ((clus_mnn + theme( plot.title=element_blank())) + dicer_sel_clus_mnn) + plot_annotation(title = "Integrated: MNN")


ggsave(paste0(here::here(), "/defaria/snRNA/plots/umaps/1.8/integrated/tumors/mnn/mnn_plots.png"), mnn_plots,height = 16, width = 14, units = "in")
```


#### DEG

##### By group

Remember:

log2FoldChange \> 0 → higher in lower-group log2FoldChange \< 0 → higher in upper-group

```{r deg_lower_vs_upper}
library(DESeq2)

group_mnn@meta.data$orig.ident <- factor(gsub(".*_(GSM[0-9]+)", "\\1", group_mnn@meta.data$orig.ident))

counts_group_mnn <- GetAssayData(group_mnn, layer = "counts")

coldata_group_mnn <- group_mnn@meta.data
coldata_group_mnn$cluster_group <- factor(coldata_group_mnn$cluster_group)


dds_group_mnn <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(
  countData = counts_group_mnn,
  colData = coldata_group_mnn,
  design = ~ orig.ident + cluster_group 
)

dds_group_mnn <- DESeq(dds_group_mnn)

res_lower_vs_upper_mnn <- results(
  dds_group_mnn,
  contrast = c("cluster_group", "lower-group", "upper-group")
)

res_lower_vs_upper_mnn <- res_lower_vs_upper_mnn[!is.na(res_lower_vs_upper_mnn$stat), ]

# Create ranked vector (Wald statistic is commonly used)
gene_list_lower_vs_upper <- res_lower_vs_upper_mnn$stat
names(gene_list_lower_vs_upper) <- rownames(res_lower_vs_upper_mnn)

# Sort decreasing
gene_list_lower_vs_upper <- sort(gene_list_lower_vs_upper, decreasing = TRUE)


res_lower_vs_upper_mnn_sig <- res_lower_vs_upper_mnn[which(res_lower_vs_upper_mnn$padj < 0.05), ]
res_lower_vs_upper_mnn_sig <- res_lower_vs_upper_mnn_sig[order(res_lower_vs_upper_mnn_sig$padj), ]


res_lower_vs_upper_mnn_sig <- as.data.frame(res_lower_vs_upper_mnn_sig) |>
  rownames_to_column("Gene") |>
  dplyr::select(-pvalue) |>
  dplyr::arrange("stat") |>
  gt() |>
  fmt_number(
    columns = where(is.numeric),
    decimals = 2
  )  |>
  fmt(
    columns = padj,
    fns = function(x) {
      dplyr::case_when(
        x < 0.001 ~ "< .001",
        x < 0.01  ~ "< .01",
        x < 0.05  ~ "< .05",
        TRUE      ~ sprintf("%.2f", x)
      )
    }
  ) |>
  tab_style(
    style = list(
      cell_fill(color = "lightcyan"),
      "font-variant: small-caps;",
      cell_text(v_align = "middle")
    ),
    locations = cells_body(columns = Gene)
  ) |>
  tab_header(
    title = "2_12_23 vs 24_19_10_13_16_17",
    subtitle = "Genes that differentiate cluster groups"
  )

gtsave( res_lower_vs_upper_mnn_sig, paste0(here::here(), "/defaria/snRNA/plots/umaps/1.8/integrated/tumors/mnn/res_lower_vs_upper_mnn_sig.html"))
```

##### By cluster

This means:

The stat column in DESeq2 output is the Wald statistic (by default), essentially:

*stat = log2FoldChange / standard error*

*"Intercept"* → baseline expression (not a comparison; ignore for differential interpretation) *Positive stat / log2FC* → higher expression in A than B *Negative stat / log2FC* → lower expression in A than B

```{r only_rgc}

rgc_clusts <- subset(split_snrna, subset = celltype_mnn == "RGC")

clus_mnn <- AggregateExpression(
  rgc_clusts,
  group.by = c("mnn_clusters","orig.ident"),
  assays = "RNA",
  slot = "counts",
  return.seurat = TRUE
)

clus_mnn@meta.data$orig.ident <- factor(gsub(".*_(GSM[0-9]+)", "\\1", clus_mnn@meta.data$orig.ident))


counts_clus_mnn <- GetAssayData(clus_mnn, layer = "counts")
coldata_clus_mnn <- clus_mnn@meta.data
coldata_clus_mnn$cluster_group <- factor(coldata_clus_mnn$mnn_clusters)
```

#### GSEA

```{r lower_vs_upper_gsea}
library(clusterProfiler)
library(org.Hs.eg.db)  

gene_df_lower_vs_upper <- bitr(names(gene_list_lower_vs_upper),
                fromType = "SYMBOL",
                toType = "ENTREZID",
                OrgDb = org.Hs.eg.db)

# Merge with ranked list
gene_list_entrez_lower_vs_upper <- gene_list_lower_vs_upper[gene_df_lower_vs_upper$SYMBOL]
names(gene_list_entrez_lower_vs_upper) <- gene_df_lower_vs_upper$ENTREZID

gene_list_entrez_lower_vs_upper <- sort(gene_list_entrez_lower_vs_upper, decreasing = TRUE)

gsea_res_lower_vs_upper <- gseGO(
  geneList = gene_list_entrez_lower_vs_upper,
  OrgDb = org.Hs.eg.db,
  ont = "BP",
  minGSSize = 10,
  maxGSSize = 500,
  pvalueCutoff = 0.05,
  verbose = FALSE,
  nPermSimple = 100000,
  eps = 0
)

gsea_res_lower_vs_upper_kegg <- gseKEGG(geneList = gene_list_entrez_lower_vs_upper,
              organism     = 'hsa',
              minGSSize    = 120,
              pvalueCutoff = 0.05,
              verbose      = FALSE,
              nPermSimple = 100000,
  eps = 0)

library(ReactomePA)
gsea_res_lower_vs_upper_react <- gsePathway(geneList = gene_list_entrez_lower_vs_upper,
                          organism = "human",
                          minGSSize = 15,
                          maxGSSize = 500,
                          eps = 0,
                          nPermSimple = 100000,
                          seed = TRUE)

fgsea_res_lower_vs_upper <- fgsea(
  pathways = gene_sets,
  stats = gene_list_entrez_lower_vs_upper,
  eps = 0,
  nPermSimple = 10000
  )

fgsea_res_lower_vs_upper <- fgsea_res_lower_vs_upper %>%
  mutate(direction = ifelse(NES > 0, "Upregulated", "Downregulated"))

top_up_lower_vs_upper <- fgsea_res_lower_vs_upper %>%
  filter(direction == "Upregulated") %>%
  arrange(padj) %>%
  head(10)

top_down_lower_vs_upper <- fgsea_res_lower_vs_upper %>%
  filter(direction == "Downregulated") %>%
  arrange(padj) %>%
  head(10)

top_all_lower_vs_upper <- bind_rows(top_up_lower_vs_upper, top_down_lower_vs_upper)

ggplot(top_all_lower_vs_upper, aes(x = NES, y = reorder(pathway, NES))) +
  geom_col(aes(fill = NES > 0)) +
  labs(x = "NES", y = "Pathway") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("TRUE" = "steelblue", "FALSE" = "tomato")) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

topPathways_g20_g21 <- fgsea_res_g20_g21[head(order(pval), n=20)][order(NES), pathway]
plotGseaTable(gene_sets[topPathways_g20_g21], gene_list_entrez_g20_g21,
              fgsea_res_g20_g21, gseaParam=0.5)

p1 <- dotplot(gsea_res_lower_vs_upper, x = "NES")

p2 <- dotplot(gsea_res_lower_vs_upper_kegg, x = "NES")

p3 <- dotplot(gsea_res_lower_vs_upper_react, x = "NES")

enrichment_mnn <- (p1 + ggtitle("GO enrichment")) + 
  (p2 + ggtitle("KEGG enrichment"))  + 
  (p3 + ggtitle("Reactome enrichment"))  & plot_annotation(title = "Clusters 2 12 23 vs 24 19 10 13 16 17")

ggsave(paste0(here::here(), "/defaria/snRNA/plots/umaps/1.8/integrated/tumors/mnn/enrichment_lower_mnn.png"), enrichment_mnn, height = 6, width = 24, units = "in")

ridgeplot(gsea_res_lower_vs_upper_kegg)

```

| Phase | What’s happening | G2M checkpoint genes? |
|----|----|----|
| **G1** | Cell growth, decision to divide | low |
| **S** | DNA replication | low–moderate (different programs dominate) |
| **G2/M** | Final prep + mitosis | **high** |

```{r read_new_data}
split_snrna <- RunPCA(split_snrna, verbose = FALSE, seed.use = 2026, npcs = 50)

celltype_mnn <- c(
                  "1"= "RGC",
                  "2"= "Neuroblasts",
                  "3"= "RGC",
                  "4"= "NEC-like RGC",
                  "5"= "RGC", 
                  "6"= "RGC",
                  "7"= "Neuroblasts/Neurons",
                  "8"= "RGC-cycling",
                  "9"= "Neuroblasts",
                  "10"= "Neuroblasts",
                  "11"= "Neuroblasts",
                  "12"= "RGC",
                  "13"= "Neuroblasts",
                  "14"= "NEC-like RGC",
                  "15"= "Neuroblasts",
                  "16"= "Neuroblasts",
                  "17"= "Neuroblasts",
                  "18"= "Astrocytes",
                  "19"= "IPC",
                  "20"= "RGC",
                  "21"= "RGC",
                  "22"= "Microglia",
                  "23"= "NEC-like RGC",
                  "24"= "IPC",
                  "25"= "Oligodendrocytes",
                  "26"= "RGC"
                  )

Idents(split_snrna) <- "mnn_clusters"

split_snrna@meta.data["celltype_mnn"]  <- celltype_mnn[as.character(Idents(split_snrna))]

jessa <- readRDS(paste0(here::here(), "/defaria/scRNA/jessa/data/raw/so_etmr1_anotado.rds"))

jessa <- NormalizeData(jessa, normalization.method = "LogNormalize",
  scale.factor = 10000)

jessa.anchors <- FindTransferAnchors(reference = split_snrna, query = jessa, dims = 1:30,
    reference.reduction = "pca")

predictions <- TransferData(anchorset = jessa.anchors, refdata = split_snrna$celltype_mnn, dims = 1:30)

jessa <- AddMetaData(jessa, metadata = predictions)

jessa$prediction.match <- jessa$predicted.id == jessa$cell_types_etmr1
table(jessa$prediction.match)


split_snrna <- RunUMAP(split_snrna, dims = 1:30, reduction = "integrated.mnn", return.model = TRUE, reduction.name = "mnn.umap")

mnn_type_long <- split_snrna@meta.data  |>
  rownames_to_column("cell") |>
  dplyr::select(
    cell,
    orig.ident, 
    mnn_clusters, 
    names(celltypes)
    ) |>
  pivot_longer(

    )


violin_mnn <- mnn_type_long |>
  ggplot(aes(x = mnn_clusters, y = value)) +

  facet_wrap(vars(cell_type), labeller = as_labeller(celltypes))

ref_p <- DimPlot(jessa, reduction = "ref.umap", group.by = "predicted.celltype", label = TRUE,
```

```{r}
  dplyr::select(orig.ident, mnn_clusters, Tumor_Type, cluster_group, celltype_mnn, `Age (months)`) |>
  rownames_to_column("cell") |>
  dplyr::mutate(ID = paste0(orig.ident, " (", Tumor_Type, ")", " (", `Age (months)`, ") "))

mnn_hist_id <- plot_hist(mnn_umapdf, "mnn_clusters", "ID") + labs(title = "Sample ID", fill = "Sample ID")

mnn_hist_id_ct <- plot_hist(mnn_umapdf, "ID", "celltype_mnn") + labs(title = "Cell type by ID", fill = "Cell type")

ggsave(paste0(here::here(), "/defaria/snRNA/plots/umaps/1.8/integrated/tumors/mnn/mnn_hist_id_ct.png"), mnn_hist_id_ct,height = 7, width = 6, units = "in")

mnn_hist_mut_ct <- plot_hist(mnn_umapdf, "Tumor_Type", "celltype_mnn") + labs(title = "Cell type by mutation", fill = "Cell type")

ggsave(paste0(here::here(), "/defaria/snRNA/plots/umaps/1.8/integrated/tumors/mnn/mnn_hist_mut_ct.png"), mnn_hist_mut_ct,height = 7, width = 6, units = "in")

celltype_plot <- DimPlot(split_snrna, group.by = "celltype_mnn", label = TRUE) + NoLegend() + ggtitle("Cell type")
ggsave(paste0(here::here(), "/defaria/snRNA/plots/umaps/1.8/integrated/tumors/mnn/celltype_plot.png"), celltype_plot,height = 7, width = 6, units = "in")

mnn_hist_id_clusg <- plot_hist(mnn_umapdf, "ID", "cluster_group") + labs(title = "Sample ID", fill = "Sample ID")

ggsave(paste0(here::here(), "/defaria/snRNA/plots/umaps/1.8/integrated/tumors/mnn/mnn_hist_id_clusg.png"), mnn_hist_id_clusg,height = 6, width = 6, units = "in")

mnn_hist_mut <- plot_hist(mnn_umapdf, "mnn_clusters", "Tumor_Type") + labs(title = "Mutation", fill = "Mutation")

mnn_id_pct <- mnn_umapdf |>
  dplyr::count(mnn_clusters, orig.ident) |>
  group_by(mnn_clusters) |>
  mutate(percentage = n / sum(n) * 100)

mnn_mut_pct <- mnn_umapdf |>
  dplyr::count(mnn_clusters, Tumor_Type) |>
  group_by(mnn_clusters) |>
  mutate(percentage = round(n / sum(n) * 100,2)) 

dicer_sel_clus_mnn <- mnn_mut_pct |>
  dplyr::filter(Tumor_Type == "Dicer" & 75 > percentage & percentage >= 25) |>
  ungroup() |>
  dplyr::rename() |>
  gt(groupname_col = "Tumor_Type",
    row_group_as_column = TRUE) |>
  cols_label(
    mnn_clusters = "Cluster",
    n = "# of cells",
    percentage = "Percentage"
  ) |>
  tab_style(
    style = list(
      cell_fill(color = "lightcyan"),
      "font-variant: small-caps;",
      cell_text(v_align = "middle")
    ),
    locations = cells_row_groups()
  ) |>
  tab_header(
    title = "Selected clusters",
    subtitle = "Leiden clustering on MNN-corrected data (res = 1.8)"
  )

mnn_plots <- ((id_mnn + theme(legend.position = "none", plot.title=element_blank())) + 
    (mnn_hist_id + theme(plot.title=element_blank()))) /
  ((mutation_mnn + theme(legend.position = "none", plot.title=element_blank())) + 
     (mnn_hist_mut + theme(plot.title=element_blank())))/
  ((clus_mnn + theme( plot.title=element_blank())) + dicer_sel_clus_mnn) + plot_annotation(title = "Integrated: MNN")


ggsave(paste0(here::here(), "/defaria/snRNA/plots/umaps/1.8/integrated/tumors/mnn/mnn_plots.png"), mnn_plots,height = 16, width = 14, units = "in")
```

```{r}
split_snrna <- readRDS(paste0(here::here(), "/defaria/snRNA/data/mnn_corrected_combined.rds"))

split_snrna <- RunUMAP(split_snrna, reduction = "integrated.mnn", dims = 1:30, n.components = 3, seed.use = 42, reduction.name = "umap")


cds <- as.cell_data_set(split_snrna)

reducedDims(cds)$UMAP <- Embeddings(split_snrna, "umap")

colData(cds)$cluster <- split_snrna$mnn_clusters

colData(cds)$celltype <- split_snrna$celltype_mnn #check that this matches everywhere
gc()

# Build Monocle's internal graph/partitions

cds@clusters$UMAP$partitions <- setNames(as.factor(rep(1, length(cds@colData@rownames))), cds@colData@rownames)

cds@clusters$UMAP$clusters <- colData(cds)$cluster

cds <- learn_graph(cds, use_partition = FALSE)

gc()

qs_save(cds, "/home/sofia/Projects/etmr/defaria/mouse/data/tumor_sing_tr.qs2", nthreads = 6)
```
